scope: Source and saved-output BR-034 audit; no source authoring, flow fitting, solver/model run, clinical adjudication or score replacement
scorer_limits: Sampled symmetric nearest-neighbor distances use vertices, centroids and edge midpoints, not exact continuous Hausdorff distance
Absolute signed volume in original score does not by itself verify positive global winding
No general self-intersection or myocardial material test
Initial reference is supplied; separate recovered later frames
limits: One selected development patient and one model attempt do not establish a capability ceiling or clinical accuracy.
All scans are public and pretraining exposure is unknown.
Native archive bytes match publisher LFS hashes; publisher array-hash serialization was not reproduced by raw C-order hashing.
Reference surfaces are operator/software-derived and may contain errors; there is no independent cardiologist adjudication.
Initial reference surfaces are supplied; this is not raw segmentation from scratch.
LV endocardial surface indices do not establish myocardial material tracking or strain.
Functional-reference labels do not establish heart-failure syndrome, valve disease or disease etiology.
Image-only and post-model impressions from one session are descriptive, not a controlled diagnostic-benefit comparison.
The preserved-function control was added after dispatch and replaced on input-quality grounds before model completion.
reviewer: assistant; computational and selected-still audit, no clinical adjudication

visual_inspection.scope: Selected stills of three source cases at their reference minimum-volume frame; three fixed orthogonal planes, each with source-only, solver-section and private-reference panels. Full-cycle motion and integrated story acceptance remain unperformed.
visual_inspection.display: Original 1 mm Cartesian reslices displayed at 2x nearest-neighbor magnification; identical pixels in all three columns. Cyan solid is solver; gold dashed is private clinical reference.
observations: At the selected reference-systolic frames, the saved solver sections remain wider than the reference in the transverse view for all three cases. Longitudinal sections also show different narrowing and basal/apical extent.
The primary and hidden reduced-case references remain within the acquired sector. Visibility and geometry differ across acquisitions; these are selected cases, not matched cohorts.
Source-only panels contain ultrasound texture and no reference contours. Reference panels are a reader-only reveal, not evidence that those contours were available to the solver.

trace_review.interpretation: Tool-call inspection supports saving the initial impression before flow experiments. Original author-review raw trace candidate indices 19/29 use a different index convention; original record remains untouched.
trace_review.saved_solver: Reads current volume/calibration/initial surface; sequential TV-L1 advection and linear loop-closure correction, no patient motion table. No current executable execution was performed.

completion_boundary: Exact brief, source verification and selected stills do not constitute canonical story, media export or visual acceptance.
